gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies the same arbitrary-point sampling defect: L2 representatives and kernel evaluations are not well-defined at every stated sample point, so the sampling operators and the matrix-lemma application are not valid without restricting the domain or fixing representatives.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem applies point evaluations and sampling operators at arbitrary points even though the coefficient-space assumptions give finite, representation-independent evaluations only on a suitable full-measure set.

component_coverage.gold_component: Arbitrary-point evaluation is not representation-independent or necessarily finite under the stated L2/coefficient assumptions.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-008 gives the same one-coordinate asymptotic and counterexample showing that reciprocal summability fails for allowed low truncation orders, and it supplies the equivalent condition eta q>2.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold entry bundles distinct defects in the affine weighted construction. ISSUE-010 independently diagnoses the missing definition and normalization contract for c_k, including its effect on reciprocal summability. ISSUE-009 independently diagnoses the separate requirement that positive radii must enforce uniform ellipticity on the parameter cube. Together they cover the gold's normalization, summability-contract, and admissible-radius/ellipticity concerns; the presentations and immediate failure operations differ.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The affine weighted-ball and sampling construction lacks a complete, mathematically admissible specification: the Jacobi normalization factors must be defined and must support reciprocal summability, while the radius hypotheses must also ensure the uniformly elliptic coefficient model used by the construction. No substantive gold concern is left unrecognised; the entries use different demonstrations and expose different manifestations of the bundled defect.
gold_decisions.uncovered_gold_detail: No substantive gold concern is left unrecognised; ISSUE-010 covers the undefined constants and missing reciprocal-summability contract, while ISSUE-009 covers the independent positive-radius/uniform-ellipticity requirement.
gold_decisions.combination_explanation: The gold issue itself contains distinct independently diagnosable defects: incomplete/undefined Jacobi normalization and an independent admissibility defect in allowing merely positive radii without the conditions needed for the affine uniformly elliptic construction. ISSUE-010 self-containedly diagnoses the first defect and the associated reciprocal-summability contract. ISSUE-009 self-containedly diagnoses the second defect by giving a positive-radius counterexample with loss of ellipticity and the repair rho_j>1. Neither entry is being used to supply the other's missing mathematical argument.

component_coverage.gold_component: The factors c_k^(a,b), including c_0, are undefined, so the affine weight sequence is not fully specified.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-010 explicitly identifies the missing c_k sequence and c_0 normalization and supplies a fully specified-weight repair.

component_coverage.gold_component: The unspecified or merely positive normalization/radius data do not by themselves establish the reciprocal-weight summability contract needed by the affine sampling theorem.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-010 states that the values and growth of the missing factors determine the claimed summability and requires the repaired lemma to establish reciprocal summability rather than merely supplying positive constants.

component_coverage.gold_component: The affine coefficient hypotheses must enforce uniform ellipticity on the parameter cube; merely positive radii are insufficient for that construction.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-009 gives a positive-radius counterexample where the coefficient vanishes and the solution leaves the claimed L2 setting, then supplies the rho_j>1 uniform-ellipticity repair.
